sources.title: Convoy: Dedicated Servers Support - SCS Software blog
Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Dedicated Server Setup (Steam guide)
How to Use Admin Commands & Moderation in ETS2 (FreakHosting)

notes: The ETS2/ATS convoy dedicated server has no command channel: no RCON, no admin REST API, and no interactive server console - the eurotrucks2_server process only prints a log and is stopped with Ctrl+C. SCS's own documentation (modding wiki) lists exactly three in-game moderator chat commands - /set_time <HH:MM>, /set_rain_factor <value from 0 to 1> and /help - and they are typed by a moderator inside the game client, not sent to the server by an operator. Moderators are pre-declared by Steam ID64 in server_config.sii (moderator_list: N / moderator_list[0]: 76561198001220177) and cannot be promoted mid-session. No kick, ban, unban, player-list or broadcast command exists anywhere in SCS's documentation; the only access control the server offers is the 'password' attribute in server_config.sii and the 8-player max_players cap. SCS's launch blog says 'more extensive tools and moderation features' are planned, which is consistent with none existing today. SOURCE DISAGREEMENT: two secondary pages publish commands that do not exist - FreakHosting lists /kick <ID>, /ban <ID> and /blacklist, and the Truck Simulator Fandom wiki lists /kick, /ban, /reload plus admin_config.sii, banlist.txt and whitelist.txt files. None of these commands, files or config attributes appear in SCS's documentation or in the dedicated server package, and they are recorded here only so a later reviewer does not mistake them for evidence. The 'export_server_packages' console command sometimes cited is a GAME CLIENT console command (enabled with uset g_console "1") used to generate server_packages.sii; it is not a server command. Moderation therefore has to happen at the host level.
